generic_name: Zinc Oxide, Niacinamide, Colloidal Sulfur, Azelaic Acid, Salicylic Acid
drug_class: Topical Combination Acne and Skin Treatment
purpose: This combination product is used to treat acne, reduce redness, and improve the overall appearance of your skin. It helps control oily skin, unclog pores, and reduce the bacteria and irritation that cause breakouts. It may also help with mild skin discoloration or uneven skin tone.
how_it_works: Each ingredient works together in its own special way to fight acne. Salicylic acid and sulfur help unclog pores and remove dead skin cells, while azelaic acid fights bacteria and reduces redness. Niacinamide calms inflammation and helps control oil, and zinc oxide soothes and protects the skin — together they give your skin a full-circle defense against breakouts.
common_side_effects: You might notice some mild dryness, peeling, or flaking of the skin, especially when you first start using it. Some people feel a little tingling, itching, or mild redness right after applying it. These effects are usually temporary and get better as your skin adjusts.
warnings: Avoid getting this product in your eyes, mouth, or nose — if it happens, rinse with plenty of water. Do not use it on broken, sunburned, or very irritated skin. If you notice severe redness, swelling, or a rash that spreads, stop using it and contact your doctor. Let your doctor know if you are pregnant, breastfeeding, or using other skin treatments to avoid irritation.
typical_dosing: Usually, you apply a thin layer to the affected area of clean, dry skin once or twice a day. Always follow the directions on your specific product label or as your doctor or pharmacist tells you. Start slowly — using it once a day at first can help your skin get used to it.
